Dear  Team,

I would like to raise a complaint regarding my recent shopping experience at your store.

I hope you will look into this matter and take necessary action.

Thank you.

Sincerely,

featured_reviews.name: Manish
featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: A Satisfying Shopping Experience at Dmart

I visited Dmart today and had an overall positive shopping experience. The store was well-organized and clean, which made finding items easy. The variety of products available was impressive, ranging from groceries to household items.

One thing I appreciated was the clear pricing and discount labels on the shelves. It helped me compare prices and make informed decisions. The checkout process was smooth, with attentive staff members available to assist when needed.

However, I did notice that some sections, particularly the fresh produce area, seemed a bit crowded and could benefit from better spacing. Additionally, a few of the aisle signs were not as visible, causing a bit of confusion while navigating.

Despite these minor concerns, the wide selection of products and the competitive prices make Dmart a convenient option for my everyday shopping needs. With a little improvement in aisle signage and product placement, the store could offer an even better shopping experience. I'll definitely be visiting again for the value and convenience it provides.

featured_reviews.name: Parag Parikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
--Update to vendor response on 30th Nov 2024:
Packet is given from your store only whether you accept it or not.  This is the pack your staff gave to me. I do not know if you packed it from Jar or packed it from somewhere else. Why would a customer complain about only one product from invoice and not others? This is not the first time I made purchase from you and that is why I am utterly disappointed with your customer service. If I would not have posted photo of invoice, god knows you may have denied that I purchased anything from your store.

Before writing this review, I visited your store personally to show you the packet and that time you did not say that product is not from your store. You said that the product is yours but it got spoiled because it was not kept in fridge! You also said you had instructed me at the time of purchase to keep the product in fridge!! So for which product did you ask me to store stuff in fridge if the product I showed you in store was not yours. Also because you are storing most of your products either prepacked or in jar outside of a fridge, why are you telling others to store it in fridge !! I am sure temperature in your store AC is not below 10 degree Celsius!!  So either way your logic itself makes no sense. If you say that the Walnuts should be stored in fridge, why are you storing it in a jar or packets and selling it to customers? You should also put jar or packets in fridge , right?

I did not ask you for any refund to set the record straight. I only asked you to acknowledge that your product was faulty. If you are so clear that the walnut is from "previous" purchase,  are you trying to say that previous purchases made from your store were faulty? Why did you even put products into a packaging material supplied by your supplier of packaging material? If I would have known this earlier, I would have insisted that you pack stuff in your brand name bags.

Please learn to own up. It is because of such reasons people sometimes move to E-commerce over retail/wholesale stores!!

Original Review:
Purchased dry fruits from the shop. The shopkeeper gave me pre-packed walnuts (packed from jars or somewhere else do not know). Within just 3 - 4 days, Walnuts started developing green kai / started getting stale. Took it back to him to show the condition. They said product is good but it was not kept in fridge and hence it became bad. If that is the case, why are they keeping pre-packed bags of walnuts that too outside of fridge in their shelf? If I apply their logic, it would only mean they intentionally sold walnut not kept in fridge to customer? Adding bill and photo of product for reference. Purchase at your own discretion.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Mr. Parikh,
Thank you for being a valued customer. We would like to address some points regarding the attached photo:
1. The walnuts in the photo appear to be from an earlier purchase, though the attached invoice is from a recent transaction.
2. All our dry fruits are packed in our branded bags; however, the walnuts in the photo are not in our packaging.
3. The walnuts listed in the invoice are never pre-packed; they are always displayed in a glass jar.
4.You requested a refund for the walnuts; however, we cannot process a refund for a product that is not from our store
5. While we appreciate reviews, we kindly ask that you share genuine feedback specific to our products.
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
